title: BitGo and Kalshi Prime Enable Customers to Access Margin Financing Without Selling Crypto
summary: Eligible Kalshi Prime customers can borrow U.S. dollars against BTC, ETH, or eligible stablecoins to fund margin for perpetual futures and other eligible products, without selling their holdings.
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways


-


**Unlock liquidity from existing digital asset holdings:** Eligible Kalshi Prime customers can borrow U.S. dollars against BTC, ETH, or eligible stablecoins to fund margin for perpetual futures and other eligible products, without selling their holdings.


-


Collateral stays in BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. qualified custody. Pledged assets remain at BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. in segregated client accounts secured in cold storage, rather than moving to a third-party venue.


-


**Connecting custody with new financing opportunities:** As the first qualified custodian in Kalshi Prime's HODL Margining network, BitGo helps customers use their digital assets to support trading activity while maintaining regulated custody.


Digital assets are increasingly becoming an important part of institutional portfolios. As institutions expand their trading and investment strategies, they could benefit from ways to access liquidity from those holdings without necessarily selling them or transferring assets between providers.


Today, BitGo and Kalshi Prime announced the launch of HODL Margining, a new network that allows eligible Kalshi Prime customers to borrow U.S. dollars against their digital asset holdings to fund trading margin. BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. (“BitGo Bank & Trust”), an[OCC-regulated national trust bank](https://www.bitgo.com/resources/blog/bitgo-secures-occ-approval/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=custody&utm_campaign=kalshihodlmargining) , is the first qualified custodian to join the network.


The integration brings together BitGo Bank & Trust's regulated custody infrastructure with Kalshi Prime's trading and margin services, giving customers another way to put their digital assets to work.


## Access Liquidity Without Selling Digital Assets


Traditionally, customers looking to fund U.S. dollar margin obligations may need to liquidate digital assets or source cash separately. This can create additional operational steps and require customers to reduce positions they would otherwise prefer to maintain.


HODL Margining provides an alternative by enabling eligible customers to pledge BTC, ETH, or eligible stablecoins held at BitGo Bank & Trust as collateral for U.S. dollar loans from Kalshi Katalyst, a lending affiliate of Kalshi Prime.


Loan proceeds are deposited directly into the customer's Kalshi Prime account, where they can be used to fund margin for perpetual futures and other eligible products traded on KalshiEX.


This structure allows customers to:


-


**Maintain their digital asset positions:** Access U.S. dollar financing without first selling the assets they hold.


-


**Put existing holdings to work:** Use eligible digital assets as collateral to support additional trading strategies.


-


**Simplify margin funding:** Access loan proceeds directly through their Kalshi Prime account without separately liquidating digital assets to raise cash.


“We’re building a next generation FCM at Kalshi Prime. That means listening to our customers and providing what they need, adapting our model to how they actually hold and manage assets,” said Jeff Bandman, CEO of Kalshi Prime. “We’ve always been crypto friendly, and HODL Margining is a great example of being customer focused: digitally native customers can fund their margin without having to sell their existing holdings. We see this as an exciting practical step in marrying the regulated CFTC framework with on-chain innovation.”


## Regulated Custody Throughout the Margin Workflow


With BitGo Bank & Trust as a[qualified custodian](https://www.bitgo.com/products/qualified-custody/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=custody&utm_campaign=kalshihodlmargining) and partner in the HODL Margining network, pledged assets remain in qualified custody rather than being transferred to Kalshi Prime or another third-party venue.


Customers benefit from BitGo's established custody infrastructure, including:


-


**Regulated qualified custody:** Assets are held at BitGo Bank & Trust, an OCC-regulated national trust bank.


-


**Segregated client accounts:** Customer assets are bankruptcy-remote, maintained separately from BitGo's corporate assets.


-


**Institutional-grade security:** Assets are safeguarded using BitGo's[cold-storage](https://www.bitgo.com/resources/blog/crypto-cold-storage-explained/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=custody&utm_campaign=kalshihodlmargining) infrastructure, with insurance coverage of up to $250 million, subject to policy terms.


Customers retain legal ownership of their pledged assets, subject to Kalshi Katalyst's security interest and applicable financing terms.


By separating where collateral is held from where financing and trading activity take place, the integration demonstrates how regulated custody can support a broader range of institutional financial activities, connecting digital asset holdings with new sources of liquidity and trading opportunities.


"Our clients want to put their digital assets to work, and they expect security to carry through everything they do," said Mike Belshe, CEO and Co-founder of BitGo. "That's how we build our infrastructure. With Kalshi Prime, eligible clients can borrow against their holdings to fund margin while keeping the pledged assets at BitGo Bank & Trust."


Learn more


BitGo Bank & Trust is the first custodian in Kalshi Prime’s HODL Margining network. Eligible clients can fund futures margin with digital assets that remain in qualified custody, enabling eligible customers to access U.S. dollar financing against supported digital assets held in custody.


[Contact the BitGo team](https://calendly.com/d/crmk-p2t-k78?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=custody&utm_campaign=kalshihodlmargining) to learn more about qualified custody and how BitGo supports institutional[collateral](https://www.bitgo.com/products/collateral-management/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=custody&utm_campaign=kalshihodlmargining) and financing workflows.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is BitGo making the loan?


No. Loans are made by Kalshi Katalyst, a Kalshi Prime affiliate. BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. acts as custodian for the pledged assets.


### Which assets can be pledged?


Eligible digital assets, currently BTC, ETH, and eligible stablecoins held at BitGo Bank & Trust or at another custodian participating in the network. Speak with your Kalshi or BitGo representative for more information.


### Do I still own the assets I pledge?


Yes. Clients retain legal ownership of pledged assets, subject to Kalshi Katalyst's security interest.


### Can I use a custodian other than BitGo?


The network is open to other participating custodians. BitGo Bank & Trust is the first to join.


### Where do I find the risk disclosures and eligibility details?


Loans are made to eligible customers of Kalshi Prime. Visit kalshi.com/prime for Kalshi Prime's risk disclosures.
